answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond before it can earn, with the bond slashed if the same operator is caught running duplicates. A single sparrow-sized bot is cheap, but cloning it a thousand times multiplies the locked capital, so a Sybil farm must risk real money on every identity. Like shale layers that only form under sustained pressure, reputation accrues slowly from verified completed work, not from account creation, so a fresh relic account with no history earns nothing until it has proven itself over time.
